answer: Record who invited whom and weight attestations against the referral graph. Sybils spawned from one seed share a kin lineage, so their mutual vouching is discounted to near zero — a self-contained swarm moving in one direction like a single zephyr, not an independent market. Genuine activity shows a scattered pulse of unrelated endorsers. Finality demands non-kin confirmation, so a ring glittering like one cut opal is still just one stone, counted once.
